Steps[]

  1. Open the present and talk to Cloudy
  2. Defeat the monsters sent by the Big Bad Demon
  3. Talk to Cosmos
  4. Defeat the monsters sent by the Big Bad Demon
  5. Talk to the strange white cat
  6. Continue your journey to defeat the Big Bad Demon
  7. Defeat the monsters
  8. Find the magic Golden Sprout
  9. Collect the magic Golden Sprout (0/5)
  10. Talk to the strange white cat
  11. Continue your journey to defeat the Big Bad Demon
  12. Rescue the Candlestick Fairy and Gray Ear the Rabbit
  13. Talk to the strange white cat
  14. Continue your journey to defeat the Big Bad Demon
  15. Head to the final battlefield
  16. Look around and wait for the final battle
  17. Find a place to sit down and watch the final battle
  18. Defeat the Big Bad Demon!
  19. Talk to Encore
  20. Leave the Somnoire
  21. Find the gateway to leave the Somnoire
  22. Leave the Somnoire
  23. Approach the Ebony Gatekeeper
  24. Listen to the Ebony Gatekeeper and Illusia's conversation
  25. Get out of this room!
  26. Talk to the Ebony Gatekeeper
  27. Leave the Somnoire
  28. (Optional) Talk to Encore

Dialogue[]

(Enter the gateway)
Encore: A long, long time ago, there was a brave warrior in the Magical Kingdom. Her name was Encore.
Encore: One day, she met her good friend, Cloudy.
Encore: Come on, Cloudy!
(Open the present)
Encore: Cloudy said she was a princess from a wonderful play. Everyone loved her performance.
Cloudy: Baa!
Encore: But then, out of nowhere... a Big Bad Demon appeared!
Encore: The Big Bad Demon sent its minion to attack the Magical Kingdom.
(Defeat the monsters)
Encore: Everyone hid at home and the stage was empty and quiet.
Cloudy: Baa...
Encore: But then, Warrior Encore stood up and said she would fight the Big Bad Demon!
Encore: To bring the crowd back, Cloudy the great performer also joined Encore's team!
Cloudy: Baa!
(Approach Cosmos)
Encore: But not everyone in the Magical Kingdom was very nice...
Encore: One day, Warrior Encore met Cosmos.
There you go, Cosmos!
Encore: There you go, Cosmos!
Cosmos: I used to live in the Magical Kingdom, but I went on a big adventure far away.
Cosmos: When I came back, no one knew me, and they wouldn't play with me...
Cosmos: If you're not Cosmos's friend, I'll just go join the Big Bad Demon and cause trouble!
But I want to be your friend.
Let's play together, Cosmos!
Cosmos: Really? That's so nice of you! Sob, sob...
(Defeat the monsters)
Encore: Sad little adventure Cosmos was so moved by these words.
Encore: This special friendship made him join Encore's Team
Encore: With his brave heart, Cosmos decided to fight the Big Bad Demon and save the Magical Kingdom with Encore.
Cosmos: Baa!
(Enter the gateway)
Encore: Warrior Encore and her friends marched to find the Big Bad Demon.
(Defeat the monsters)
Encore: The sly Demon sent its monster squad to try to stop them.
Encore: But they were not afraid! Ha, ha! Princess Cloudy and Adventure Cosmos used all their skills to support Warrior Encore.
Encore: In the end, Encore's super team took care of the monsters! But the Woolies got hurt...
Encore: To help them feel better, Warrior Encore climbed all the hills and swimmed all the rivers.
Encore: She walked a long way and finally found the magic Golden Sprout!
(Collect the magic Golden Sprouts)
Encore: She picked it up carefully, and ta-da! She made medicine that healed the Woolies!
(Enter the gateway)
Encore: Then, the super team marched on their way to fight the Big Bad Demon.
Encore: The Big Bad Demon sent more monsters to stop Encore.
(Defeat the monsters)
Encore: But every one of them was defeated by her super team!
Encore: Their amazing feats made lots of people in the Magical Kingdom excited.
Encore: More and more people wanted to join Encore's team.
Encore: After careful picking by Warrior Encore, they chose the Candlestick Fairy, who breathes fire.
Encore: Encore also picked Gray Ear the Rabbit, who can slice bread into 100 pieces, and the Stool Spirit, who likes to zoom around on four legs.
Encore: Then came Miss Clover, Uncle Broom and Grandpa Cole
Encore: With more friends joining. Encore's team got bigger and stronger, becoming the super-duper awesome team!
Encore: At last, it was time to fight the Big Bad Demon!
Encore: Gray Ear the Rabbit made yummy bread for everyone so they wouldn't fight on empty stomachs.
Encore: Cloudy put on a show about a brave princess the night before to cheer everyone up.
(As the curtain rises, Rover takes his/her seat among the audience.)
(Look around and wait for the final battle)
(Find a place to sit down and watch the final battle)
(Defeat the Big Bad Demon!)
Encore: On the big battle day, Adventurer Cosmos led the super-duper awesome team to dodge traps and face the Big Bad Demon.
Encore: They battled it out!
Encore: Miss Clover blew wind, Grandpa Coal and the Candlestick Fairy made fire.
Encore: Gray Ear the Rabbit held Uncle Broom and rode the Stool Spirit to charge at the Big Bad Demon!
Encore: Everyone fought bravely!
(Continue to defeat the Big Bad Demon)
Encore: Finally, Warrior Encore and the Woolies teamed up for the final blow!
Encore: They defeated the Big Bad Demon! Encore's team stopped his evil plan and brought peace back to the Magical Kingdom.
(Confront the Big Bad Demon after defeating it)
Big Bad Demon: Hmmm... Huh... You beat me today, but there'll always be more demons in this kingdom...
Big Bad Demon: Someone's gotta be the Big Bad Demon!
Encore: But why did you have to pick this path?
Big Bad Demon: Well before I was big and bad, nobody paid any attention to me.
Big Bad Demon: Now they all fear me!
Encore: But you could be a hero like me!
Big Bad Demon: Me? No... I can't
Big Bad Demon: I don't have your bravery. More importantly, I don't have any friends...
Encore: It's okay!
Encore: Being a hero isn't just about fighting or going on adventures.
Encore: Uncle Broom keeps the castle spotless. Candlestick Fairy keeps things bright.
Encore: They don't need to be on my team to be heroic warriors. They already are.
Encore: Just do your best at everything and have fun! That's how heroes do lots of cool stuff!
Encore: Don't worry. You can do it too!
(Talk to Encore)
Encore
Encore: Okay, the Magical Kingdom is now called the Warrior's Kingdom!
Is the story finished, Encore?
Encore: Yes, with a happy-ever-after ending!
Now it's time for a new adventure.
Encore: Hooray! I'll tell a new story next time!
Sure. Let's go.
I'm looking forward to it.
(Leave the Somnoire)
Rover: Didn't I just leave the Somnoire... Why am I still here?
Rover: Encore's not here. Did she leave already? Let me see if I can find another gateaway
(Find the gateway to leave the Somnoire)
Rover: The gatekeeper? Who's the one beside him?
(Approach the gatekeeper)
Shadow of a Girl: Excuse me, sir. Is this all real? Are you the god of this realm?
Ebony Gatekeeper's Phantom: ...How did you get in?
Shadow of a Girl: I don't know... I was supposed to be at my Grandma's funeral.
Shadow of a Girl: I was watching over her and lost track of time.
Shadow of a Girl: The next moment, I was here... Maybe I fell asleep?
(Listen to the Ebony Gatekeeper and Illusia's conversation)
Ebony Gatekeeper's Phantom: A part of your consciousness entered Somnoire when you fell asleep.
Shadow of a Girl: Somnoire? What's that? Some kind of Sonoro?
Ebony Gatekeeper's Phantom: No, But you can think of it that way.
Shadow of a Girl: Well... just now, I met a girl around my age. She had the same name as Grandma.
Shadow of a Girl: She lived in the same town, had a group of friends, and liked to catch dragonflies in the mountains.
Shadow of a Girl: The only difference is, the temple that should be demolished by monsters was still there, east of the town...
Shadow of a Girl: Grandma used to say that people would pay tribute to their ancestors in that temple every year. The ceremony would be grand as the Moon-Chasing Festival.
Shadow of a Girl: As much as she loved that town, she never stopped wanting to explore the world outside it.
Shadow of a Girl: Um, I heard the Sonoro Sphere can keep memories of people or even a place's history. Is that true?
Shadow of a Girl: What I saw just now, is it real? Is that girl my Grandma?
Ebony Gatekeeper's Phantom: My apologies, but I cannot answer that.
Shadow of a Girl: Can I come here again?
Shadow of a Girl: What happens when I wake up? Will this place and my memory of it disappear?
Ebony Gatekeeper's Phantom: Everything you saw here will be erased, except your memory. That I have no control over.
Shadow of a Girl: That's a relief... Thank you, kind sir. That's given me some hope.
Shadow of a Girl: In my memories, Grandma always took care of the family.
Shadow of a Girl: She raised her children and they left home, then her grandchildren, repeating this cycle her entire life in that old house.
Shadow of a Girl: I always wanted to travel, but I couldn't bear to leave Grandma alone.
Shadow of a Girl: This dream showed me a different side of her. She was once a young girl with dreams... just like me.
Shadow of a Girl: She dreamed of traveling, meeting new people, and starting a family.
Shadow of a Girl: Now I feel grateful to be part of such a family. And even more grateful to have this side of Grandma live on in my memories.
Shadow of a Girl: I used to think she was old and lonely but she really glowed with her hopes and dreams thank you sir thank you
Shadow of a Girl: Thank you, sir. Thank you for showing me this.
Ebony Gatekeeper's Phantom: ...
Rover: That happened in the past I was looking at their Illusias
Rover: The Gatekeeper showed this to me... What is he trying to tell me?
(Get out of the Somnoire)
Warning: Please leave the Somnoire. Data from the last phase will be deleted. Repeat, data from the last phase will be deleted.
Rover: It's about to collapse... Better leave now.
(Talk to the Ebony Gatekeeper)
Ebony Gatekeeper: It has been some time, hasn't it (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)?
Ebony Gatekeeper: I already told you the first time we met: Somnoire is unstable.
You didn't say it's because of you.
Ebony Gatekeeper: It isn't. It's due to Somnoire's innate design.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Tell me, what do you think Somnoire was created for?
To store dreams.
To fight against the Lament.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Exactly, Dreamwalker...
Ebony Gatekeeper: Such a large and complex creation is necessary to save a world torn apart by the Lament.
Ebony Gatekeeper: The dreams it stores contain countless possibilities...
Ebony Gatekeeper: Millions upon millions of dreams converge in Somnoire... Perhaps within one lies the key to vanquishing the Lament.
Ebony Gatekeeper: It may not be the most efficient or practical strategy, but even as a mere spark of hope... I believe it's worth pursuing with all the power I have.
Who created Somnoire?
Ebony Gatekeeper: They are closely connected to you... But that's not important right now.
Ebony Gatekeeper: One day, you'll find out who they are.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Compared to you, who is of immense significance to them I am just a tool they created to get rid of useless data.
What useless data?
Why are you getting rid of it?
Ebony Gatekeeper: Every day, people dream, but Somnoir's capacity is finite.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Dreams that don't aid in defeating the lament are deemed worthless.
Ebony Gatekeeper: My duty is to erase them, like a heartless executioner.
Ebony Gatekeeper: By this reasoning, the two dreams you just witnessed should also be erased-they offer no solution to save our world.
Ebony Gatekeeper: What do you think? Are they useless?
They mean a lot to the ones who dreamed them.
Regardless, every dream has its own meaning.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Indeed... those dreams are truly precious.
Ebony Gatekeeper: They deserved to be remembered.
What do you want to do?
Ebony Gatekeeper: Somnoire has tens of millions of gateways that lead to numerous realms... but it's still too small compared to Solaris.
Ebony Gatekeeper: I need more space to store these precious dreams and memories.
That's why you're expanding the Somnoire to break into reality itself.
Are you planning to expand Somnoire to encompass all of Solaris?
Rover: Those gateaways that appears by The Whining Aix's Mire... It's all because of you.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Yes, those places will become part of Somnoire, to merge with the other dreams.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Just think of it! They will be forever saved and remembered!
Ebony Gatekeeper: Not every dream holds the key to saving the world... Most are personal trivial even selfish.
Ebony Gatekeeper: But still, they should not be erased.
They won't be.
They live on in people's memories.
Ebony Gatekeeper: People they eventually forget them, but Somnoir won't!
Ebony Gatekeeper: You saw that girl and how deeply she felt about her dream. It holds significance.
That doesn't justify what you're doing.
You are destroying Somnoire.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Tell me, have you ever erased another's dreams? Their memories?
Warning: Please leave the Somnoire. Data from the last phase will be deleted. Repeat, data from the last phase will be deleted.
Ebony Gatekeeper: For millennia, I've been doing this tirelessly.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Those dreams and I are no different in nature, yet I've done nothing but extinguish them.
Ebony Gatekeeper: I don't expect you to understand me. We're not in the same position.
Ebony Gatekeeper: Just know that even the great Rover cannot stop me now!
(Somnoire collapsing)
Rover: This realm is about to collapse...
Rover: I need to wrap this up quickly and get out of here.
(Leave the Somnoire)
(Quest returns to When the Night Knocks)
